ordered_diagnoses: Pemphigus herpetiformis variant with IgG and C3 deposition

s1.syndrome_frame: Painful erosive skin lesion around a stoma site with suprabasal epidermal splitting and acantholysis
salient_findings: Painful, erosive lesion around the stoma on the anterior abdominal wall
Suprabasal epidermal splitting with acantholysis on histopathology
Intercellular deposition of IgG and C3 throughout epidermis on direct immunofluorescence
key_facts: Patient has a 10-year history of Crohn disease
Patient underwent total proctocolectomy and ileostomy
Painful, erosive lesion developed 5 weeks after surgery
Lesion is located around the stoma on the anterior abdominal wall
Repeated microbiological cultures were negative
Histopathology showed epidermal erosion with suprabasal epidermal splitting and acantholysis
Direct immunofluorescence showed intercellular deposition of IgG and C3 throughout epidermis
High levels of IgG autoantibodies against desmoglein 1 and desmoglein 3 were detected
